#     path | rule-id | sha256 fingerprint | reason

# The format, what an entry may say, and why this is a directory rather than a
# file are argued once in README.md beside this file. Do not restate them here.

# covers: tools/


# The scaffold's own suite.
#
# tools/new-service renders a service's Compose unit and writes the entries
# its literals owe; its suite pins what that render produces, which puts the
# rendered broker account in the suite as well.

tools/new-service/test_new_service.py | credential-assignment | 1c47d06cedb2 | The scaffold suite pinning the per-service broker account it renders into compose.
tools/new-service/test_new_service.py | connection-string-password | 19b974097990 | The scaffold suite pinning the per-service Redis user it renders into compose.
